metadata.title: Coarse geometry of metric measure spaces
metadata.abstract: Using ideas from optimal transport theory, we introduce a notion of measured coarse equivalence for metric measure spaces and define a corresponding variant of the uniformly finite homology of Block and Weinberger, called weighted $\ell^\infty$ homology, for large-scale doubling metric measure spaces. We prove that this homology is invariant under measured coarse equivalence and that the vanishing of its zeroth homology is equivalent to weighted non-amenability. The proofs combine techniques from optimal transport theory and the disintegration of measures.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 度量测度空间的粗不变量
analysis.workSummary: 定义测度粗等价和大尺度 doubling 空间的加权 l∞ 同调，证明其在测度粗等价下不变，并以零次同调消失刻画加权非 amenability。
analysis.breakthrough: 把测度结构纳入粗几何同调，并连接可检测的非 amenability 条件。
analysis.limitations: 需要大尺度 doubling 背景；测度粗等价与常见粗等价的区别待正文核对。 当前为摘要级数学分析，主结果和证明尚未逐段核查；AI 披露另见独立核查记录。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第 5 页致谢明确声明 AI 仅用于英语语言编辑；确认写作辅助并排除其他用途。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。第 5 页致谢明确声明 AI 仅用于英语语言编辑；确认写作辅助并排除其他用途。

analysis.priorityReason: 概念接口和零次同调判据适合度量测度与粗几何交叉读者。
